action: Tap the bell icon at the top of the chart
response: Alert manager screen opens over the chart
result: All existing account alerts listed
persist: Server-side; alerts are ACCOUNT-scoped not layout-scoped
notes: TV blog 2020-07-14 confirms an iOS alert-management screen with two tabs (alerts / log).

action: Tap + to create a new alert
response: Alert creation form opens with current symbol prefilled
result: Blank alert ready to configure
notes: Secondary source describes mobile flow: bell icon > plus icon > pick type.

action: Tap the + next to the price on the price scale
response: Context menu offers 'add alert at <price>' plus default alerts on chart indicators
result: One more tap creates a Crossing alert at that exact level
notes: THIS IS THE MINIMUM-TAP PATH. Official doc documents the price-scale + button but does not label it mobile.

action: Press and hold on the chart ~1 second
response: Crosshair appears with price readout and a + affordance
result: Enables the quick-alert entry point at the touched price
notes: CONFLICT: app v2.139.0 says long-pressing the PRICE SCALE now opens Chart settings. Long-press on CANVAS (crosshair) vs on PRICE SCALE (settings) appear to be different targets. Unresolved.

action: Choose current symbol or a watchlist as alert scope
response: Picker of symbol vs watchlist
result: Alert scope set
notes: Official label: 'Symbols - Choose whether to set an alert for the current symbol or a watchlist.' Platform-agnostic; mobile rendering inferred.

action: Select the primary condition source (Price, indicator, drawing, strategy, chart pattern)
response: List of available sources on the current chart
result: Determines whether the alert is a PRICE alert or a TECHNICAL alert
persist: Determines which plan quota it consumes
notes: Price alerts = symbol + price value + Crossing/Greater/Less only. Anything using overlays, indicators, drawings, strategies, channel/moving operators, or multiple conditions is TECHNICAL with a separate quota. Basic plan gets 0 technical alerts.

action: Pick the trigger operator
response: Operator list appears
result: 13 operators: Crossing, Crossing up, Crossing down, Greater than, Less than, Entering channel, Exiting channel, Inside channel, Outside channel, Moving up, Moving down, Moving up %, Moving down %
notes: Price alerts expose only the first FIVE. Channel and Moving operators ALWAYS classify the alert as technical, so unavailable on Basic.

action: Enter threshold price or pick a second series
response: Numeric keypad or second-series picker
result: Right side of the condition set
notes: Official presets doc: 'Value fields, drawing tools, and webhook URLs are not preserved in presets.'

action: Choose how often the alert may fire
response: Options: Only once, Once per bar, Once per bar close, Once per minute / Every time
result: Firing policy set
notes: 'Only once' auto-stops the alert on trigger (status 'Stopped - Triggered'). A separate help article 'Why is the Once Per Bar option missing?' implies conditional availability.

action: Set the date the alert stops
response: Date picker
result: Alert auto-expires; status 'Stopped - Expired'
notes: Default cap: Basic 1 month, Essential/Plus/Premium 2 months.

action: Toggle 'Open-ended alert' so the alert never expires
response: Expiration date field disabled
result: Alert runs indefinitely (auto-deactivated after 1 year inactive)
notes: Official: 'the Open-ended alert feature is not available for alerts on watchlists.' Premium/Ultimate only.

action: Type a name shown in the alert manager
response: Keyboard opens
result: Alert labeled for later identification
notes: A dedicated help article covers name and message size limits; exact byte caps not retrieved.

action: Type the notification body; supports placeholders {{close}}, {{ticker}}
response: Keyboard opens
result: Message delivered with the notification and to webhook payloads
notes: Placeholder support is server-rendered hence platform-agnostic. Whether the iOS keyboard offers a placeholder-insertion helper is unverified.

action: Enable push delivery to the mobile app
response: Checkbox toggles on
result: Alert pushes to device AND becomes eligible for the iOS Alerts log
notes: Official: 'Alerts created in the mobile app have this feature enabled automatically by default' and it is 'available to all users regardless of subscription tier.'

action: Enable email delivery to the profile address
response: Checkbox toggles on
result: Email sent on trigger
notes: An alternative address can be configured for notifications.

action: Enable plain-text email to a specified address
response: Address field appears
result: Plain-text email; used as an email-to-SMS bridge
notes: IMPORTANT: TradingView has NO native SMS channel. 'SMS' in third-party guides means carrier email-to-SMS gateways, which AT&T has discontinued. No SMS row on the pricing page.

action: Enable webhook and paste a POST endpoint
response: URL field appears
result: HTTP POST with the alert message on trigger
persist: Server-side; NOT stored in alert presets
notes: Pricing page: Basic no; Essential/Plus/Premium/Ultimate yes. Typing a URL on a phone keyboard is the practical friction point.

action: Enable an audible alert
response: Sound + duration selectors appear
result: Sound plays on trigger in the open client
notes: Client-side channel; whether iOS plays it while backgrounded is unverified.

action: Enable browser/desktop toast
response: Checkbox toggles
result: Toast shown in web/desktop clients
portrait: Toggle row likely present but INERT on iOS
notes: A desktop/browser channel. Whether the iOS form even renders it is unverified - a likely divergence point between mobile sheet and desktop dialog.

action: Apply a saved alert template
response: Condition, operator, frequency, expiration, name, message and notification toggles populate
result: Near-instant alert configuration; up to 5 presets stored
notes: Presets cannot be edited - only deleted and recreated. Presence in the iOS sheet is NOT verified; this is the single biggest potential tap-count saver on mobile.

action: Commit the alert
response: Sheet dismisses; alert line drawn on chart at the level
result: Server-side alert active; fires even with the app closed
notes: Fails with a quota error if the plan's price/technical/watchlist limit is hit.

action: Tap the drawn trendline to select it
response: Drawing action bar appears with a bell icon among the tools
result: Bell icon available to attach an alert to the drawing
persist: Alert binds to the drawing and moves with it if the line is adjusted
notes: Optimus Futures mobile short 2025-06-04. Drawing alerts are TECHNICAL alerts, so Basic plan cannot create them.

target: Bell icon in drawing context toolbar
action: Tap the bell to open the alert form pre-bound to the drawing
response: Create alert sheet opens with the drawing as condition source
result: Operators include Crossing, Entering/Exiting channel, Inside/Outside channel depending on tool
notes: Officially supported drawing alert targets: lines, channels, rectangles, Anchored VWAP, Fib retracements and trend-based extensions.

action: Tap the indicator to reveal actions, choose Add alert
response: Create alert sheet opens with the indicator's plots as condition sources
result: Alert on an indicator plot or a Pine alertcondition/alert() call
persist: Alert stores the indicator's settings AT CREATION TIME
notes: Official footgun: 'If the indicator parameter is changed after the alert is created, then the alert will be triggered using the old settings.'

action: Select the strategy as the alert source
response: Three options: order fills and alert() calls, order fills only, alert() calls only
result: Alert fires on backtest order events
notes: Counts against the technical-alert quota. Pine Editor unavailable on mobile, so the strategy must already exist on the layout - mobile is consume-only for scripts.

action: Select a detected pattern as the source
response: Pattern-specific triggers (breakout, new formation, target reached)
result: Alert on auto-detected patterns
notes: Presence of auto chart patterns in the iOS app is unverified; patterns are themselves a paid feature on web.

action: Swipe left on a symbol row
response: Reveals action buttons including delete and create alert
result: Alert flow opens for that symbol WITHOUT leaving the watchlist
notes: Fastest alert path that does NOT require charting the symbol first.

target: 'Add alert on the list...' in watchlist name dropdown
action: Create one alert applying to every symbol in the list
response: Create alert dialog opens with the watchlist as symbol scope
result: Alert evaluates independently per symbol; auto-applies to symbols added later
persist: Active until it has triggered for every symbol in the list
notes: Pricing: Basic/Essential/Plus none, Premium 2, Ultimate 15. Open-ended expiration NOT available for watchlist alerts. iOS entry point UNVERIFIED - the doc describes the web watchlist dropdown.

action: Drag the alert label vertically
response: Line follows finger; price value updates live
result: Alert threshold changed without reopening the form
persist: New value saved server-side; syncs to web/desktop
notes: Official: 'Drag labels to adjust alert values directly on the chart.' Desktop-oriented, but the same doc acknowledges mobile long-tapping, so a mobile drag is plausible.

action: Long-press the dotted alert line
response: Context menu with edit / stop / delete / add-remove extended alert line
result: Alert edited or deleted in place
notes: Official doc explicitly says right-click 'or long-tapping on mobile devices' opens the context menu.

action: Long-press a row
response: Context menu: Stop/Resume, Edit, Clone, Delete
result: Alert lifecycle managed from one screen
notes: STRONGEST iOS-specific alert evidence. iOS blog lists add, delete, pause, restart, edit and CLONE, plus 'tap a notification directly or use a long-press gesture to access a context menu.'

action: Read alert state
response: Green 'Active'; orange 'Stopped - Triggered'; gray 'Stopped manually'; red 'Stopped - Expired'
result: User can tell why an alert is silent
notes: Status vocabulary is server-side, expected identical on iOS; visual chip design unverified.

action: Switch to the alerts log
response: Chronological list of triggered alerts
result: Triggered-alert history
persist: iOS log is DEVICE-scoped to delivered pushes
notes: CRITICAL iOS DIVERGENCE: 'alerts log in your iOS app contains alerts that were received as push notifications only.' If 'Notify on App' was off or the push failed, the trigger is INVISIBLE in the iOS log even though it fired. Web log has CSV export; iOS export unverified.

action: Sort by Ticker, Name, Message, Date created, or Time triggering
response: List reorders
result: Easier to find an alert in a long list
notes: Sorting and 'Customize list' columns documented for the desktop manager. Given the two-tab iOS design, may be absent.

action: Tap the delivered alert banner
response: App opens
result: Deep-link into the triggered symbol (destination UNVERIFIED)
persist: Entry added to the iOS alerts log
notes: Deep-link target not documented. Note the newer 'Notification schedule for alerts' article - quiet-hours scheduling exists but its mobile surface is unverified.

action: Attempt to create an alert beyond quota
response: Creation blocked with an error
result: Basic 3 price / 0 technical / 0 watchlist; Essential 20/20/0; Plus 100/100/0; Premium 400/400/2; Ultimate 1000/1000/15
notes: Mobile alerts consume the SAME account quota as web - no separate mobile slots. Downgrading stops alerts over the new limit.
